problems.original:
copy .env.example .env

Edit .env and set the following values:
APP_ENV=dev
PORT=8000
DEBUG=true
problems.updated:
Set the APP_MODE environment variable to 'production':

On Windows:
set APP_MODE=production

On Linux/Mac:
export APP_MODE=production
problems.fix_explanation: Updated environment variable configuration to match the actual code which requires APP_MODE set to 'production', removed unused PORT and DEBUG variables, and provided cross-platform instructions.
Corrected the application entry point from main.py to app.py as per the project structure.

problems.original:
Open your browser and visit:
http://localhost:8000

If the page loads successfully, the service has started correctly.
problems.updated:
The application should print:
Service started successfully
Port: 9123

If you see these messages, the service has started correctly.
problems.fix_explanation: Updated verification step to match the actual application behavior which prints status messages instead of running a web server, and corrected the port number to 9123 as configured in settings.yaml.
